title: Almond Pesto Pasta Salad with Broccoli, Greens & Fresh Mozzarella

steps.text: Fill a large pot halfway with hot water (from the tap), cover, and bring to a boil. Uncover, add salt and pasta, and stir for a few seconds. Cook until almost done, about 6 minutes.
Meanwhile, wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the mixed greens if they came pre-washed.)
Small dice mozzarella, place in a large bowl, and set aside.
Separate broccoli into bite-sized florets and cut stems into smaller pieces.
When the pasta is almost done, add broccoli to the pot; continue to cook, stirring occasionally, until pasta reaches desired firmness and broccoli is tender, 3-4 minutes more.
Meanwhile, peel garlic and place in a blender.
Zest and juice lemons into the blender with the garlic.

Pick basil leaves off the stems; add to the blender along with nutritional yeast, almonds, water, oil, salt, and pepper. Blend on high until very smooth, 1-2 minutes. Add to the bowl with the mozzarella.
When the pasta and broccoli are done, drain and rinse under cold water to cool; add to the bowl.
Halve tomatoes; add to the bowl, along with mixed greens, and stir to combine the pasta salad.
To serve, divide pasta salad between plates or bowls and enjoy!
